messages:
sasha: release-bot flagged preflight eval failure for canary v2.3.4-canary. link: https://ci/reports/1753254321 :eyes:
release-bot: PRELIGHT-EVAL FAILED — quality_drop=3.7% on longform_summarization_suite. Blocking canary promotion. auto-pin previous stable v2.3.3 for route text-generate-1.
mike: Quick skim — failures are hallucination spikes on long-form tests (>=2048 tokens). Sample diff below:
```
gold: Company founder is Jane Doe.
model: John Doe founded the company in 2010.
```
jen: Is this reproducible locally or only on canary infra?
sasha: I reproduced locally with same seed for some cases, but it's inconsistent — sometimes passes. Shows up more with quantized kernels + KV cache reuse.
jen: Ok running eval with seed=42 and decode params from canary (top_p=0.9, temp=0.3). Will post run id.
release-bot: NOTE: Because preflight failed, canary promotion was halted and the stable route was pinned to v2.3.3. Change window flag left untouched.
tara: Thanks. What's surface area? Any active customers impacted?
mike: Minimal customer impact so far (low traffic on that route). Contract customers might notice on very long summaries. Still want to be conservative.
sasha: Plan: open rollback/hotfix PR to disable the new kernel path for sequences >1024, add targeted eval harness for 3 long-form prompts, and run in staging. If PR fixes eval, we can unpin.
jen: Rerun started (run_id: r-20250306-09). Will share numbers in ~30m.
release-bot: Change window suggestion: next maintenance slot Tue 02:00 UTC if manual rollout needed.
mike: My recommendation: keep pin for 24h unless fix validated end-to-end. If fix looks clean, allow unpin with 2h canary observation.
jen: Rerun complete — longform suite failure rate dropped to 0.4% after disabling kernel X locally. Attaching small log excerpt:
```
r-20250306-09 summary:
longform_summarization: baseline_fail=3.7% -> postpatch=0.4%
notes: flaky cases reduced when cache invalidation added
```
jen: Created artifact: s3://redwood/ci/r-20250306-09/results.json
sasha: PR opened: #1429 — Disable kernel X for long sequences + added eval harness. CI green on staging.
tara: @mike can you hold merge until we hit 2h of canary smoke tests? If green, I'm fine with unpin.
mike: Will merge and promote to canary after autoscale tests. Monitoring hooks already set. If anything spikes, we rollback to v2.3.3 and open incident.
sasha: Merging in 10m. Will tag ops and notify customers if we unpin early.
release-bot: CANARY PROMOTION BLOCKED (automated) — awaiting manual sign-off and 2h observation window.
jen: Manual QA sign-off pending 2h canary pass. I'll post final pass timestamp. :thumbsup:
tara: Approved contingent on 2h pass. Thanks team!
